title: Senco Gold Ltd - 543936 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

summary.headline: Senco Gold Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue up 34% YoY and H1 up 52%, but margins under pressure from discounts, lower hedging and marketing spend.
summary.overview: Management reported Q2 FY27 revenue growth of about 34% YoY on a consolidated basis, with H1 growth of 52% and TTM sales crossing Rs 10,000 crore. Retail revenue grew about 29% in Q2 and same-store sales grew 19% in value. Margins were weaker as the company spent on discounts and customer acquisition, and hedging was lower at 40-50%. Management said revenue growth from 1 October to 11 November was about 25-26% (about Rs 2,400 crore), with same-store sales up about 17%.

financial_highlights.metric: Q2 FY27 revenue growth (consolidated, as stated)
H1 FY27 revenue growth (consolidated, as stated)
H1 EBITDA margin (per analyst's reading of slides, disputed by management)
financial_highlights.value: 7.6% stated by analyst; analyst calculated about 5.9% excluding other income
Analyst cited Q2 margin about 3.7% vs guided 4-4.5%; management did not confirm
Analyst noted rise to about Rs 1.2 million from Rs 1.77 million per call transcription (unclear units)

segments.name: Retail (company-operated and franchise)
segments.commentary: Retail revenue up about 29% in Q2; franchisee inventory build-up for festive season put some downward pressure on margins. Management opened 10 new stores in the last 45 days; FY27 store additions were not quantified in the call.

segments.name: Diamond jewellery
segments.commentary: Diamond jewellery sales grew about 12.5% in H1 and about 26% in the 41 days from 1 October to 11 November. Management plans continued diamond promotions for Valentine's Day and the January-February season.

guidance_outlook: Management guides to EBITDA margin of 7.5-7.8% on a full-year basis, but said macro factors may make this hard to hit in any given quarter.

Revenue growth from 1 October to 11 November was about 25-26%; same-store sales about 17%; management expects growth to continue into the festive period and the December-February wedding and Valentine's season.
Management expects the cut ratio (studded/diamond share) to return to about 12.5% in December-February from about 9.5-10% during the festive period.
Hedging target is to move from about 50% towards 65-70% over time once gold prices stabilise.
Management stated a long-term ambition of Rs 20,000 crore top line at about 8% margin, with growth of about 15%+ per year, but gave no timeline in the call.
capex_capacity: Store expansion focused on East India, Northwest and Central India, with limited expansion in South India; expansion targets smaller towns (tier 2/3/4).
10 new stores opened in the last 45 days; total FY27 store additions described only as a figure not clearly captured in the transcript.
Manufacturing base in Kolkata/Bengal cited as a skilled-artisan hub; no capacity or capex figures given.
demand_pricing: Discounts were increased in Q2 to drive customer acquisition, which pressured margins; management said it will keep investing in customer acquisition.
Gold metal loan share of working capital fell to about 17%; management attributed it to Q1 gold-import GST-related bank uncertainty that eased in Q2.
Old gold exchange buyback reduces margin by about 0.2-0.4%; management said it will keep promoting it.
About 40-45% of store footfall is new customers; 55-60% are repeat buyers.
Management sees rising demand for 9-carat and 14-carat jewellery, and lab-grown diamond jewellery, as gold prices stay high.
Competition from unorganised players using price-led offers; management expects these to be unsustainable over the long run.

qa_highlights.question: Why is margin volatile and why has it stayed below the 7.5% guidance, given peers did better this quarter?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said discounts, lower hedging (40-50%), franchisee inventory build and customer-acquisition investment drove the margin gap; it asked investors to view H1 together, which it said gave about 4% PBT-type margin, with the variance mainly from customer acquisition and market volatility.

qa_highlights.question: Why did other income rise sharply?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said other income comes from hedging gains used to protect cash flow and liquidity while offering customer schemes (Merry Gold, flexible schemes); it described the item as tied to business strategy and risk management rather than one-off.

qa_highlights.question: What is the hedging policy and how does it relate to gold prices?
qa_highlights.answer: Hedging is set by the board; it is currently about 50%, with a target of 65-70% over time once gold prices stabilise.

qa_highlights.question: What is the impact of old gold exchange on margins?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the old gold exchange reduces margin by about 0.2-0.4% due to handling costs, melting losses and opportunity loss, but it will continue to promote it.

qa_highlights.question: How will the company reach Rs 20,000 crore revenue at 8% margin, and where will expansion happen?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said growth will focus on East, Northwest and Central India, with limited South expansion; margin improvement depends on a higher studded (diamond) share in the mix, supported by new collections (Everlight, a collaboration with Melorra).

qa_highlights.question: What gold price scenario and consumer behaviour changes are expected?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said stable gold prices shift growth to operational execution and that demand is shifting towards 9-carat and 14-carat and lab-grown diamond jewellery; it expects 15%+ growth.

risks_watch: Margin volatility: Q2 margin was below the 7.5-7.8% guidance because of discounts, hedging levels and franchisee inventory build; watch whether the studded share returns to about 12.5%.
Other income is a large share of profit (hedging gains tied to customer schemes); if gold prices rise sharply the hedge position could cause losses.
Gold metal loan availability and bank appetite; share was about 17% of working capital borrowing.
Competition from unorganised and low-price players in Q2, which management said could persist for one to two years.
Analyst questions on the reported margin figures and slide data were not fully resolved in the call.
summary.management_tone: Management was confident on top-line growth and store expansion, but defensive on margins, which it attributed to discounts, hedging and franchisee inventory, and repeatedly deferred to 'long-term' views. It declined to discuss hedging in detail on the call and offered an offline discussion.
key_quotes: And the same store sales growth continues to be strong at 19% in terms of value.
So the revenue growth that we have seen from 1st of October to 11th of November has been around 25 to 26% and we have crossed around 2,400 crores of our turnover.
So we know that on taking such initiative, there is a slight pressure on the margins and that is something that we take it for the long run for the benefit of the company and the economy.

adds.what: 10 new stores opened in the last 45 days (retail footprint, East India, Northwest, Central India; smaller towns)

growth.why: Management reports Q2 FY27 revenue up about 34% and post-festive growth of 25-26% (1 Oct-11 Nov, same-store sales about 17%), backed by demand trends and 10 new stores opened recently, though FY27 store additions and the 7.5-7.8% full-year EBITDA margin guidance are not firmly backed by quantified capacity or orders and management itself cautioned the margin may be hard to hit.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Full-year EBITDA guide is 7.5-7.8%, but Q2 margin fell short (analyst cited about 3.7% vs guided 4-4.5%), and management said macro factors may make the guide hard to hit in any quarter; recovery depends on studded share returning to about 12.5% from 9.5-10% and hedging rising from about 50%.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: 10 new stores opened in the last 45 days, with store expansion focused on East, Northwest and Central India and smaller towns, but total FY27 store additions were not quantified in the call.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Revenue grew about 25-26% from 1 Oct to 11 Nov (about Rs 2,400 crore) with same-store sales up about 17%, and management expects growth to continue into the festive, wedding and Valentine's season.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: No capex or capacity figures were given; the manufacturing base in Kolkata/Bengal was cited without capex amounts.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management kept full-year EBITDA guidance at 7.5-7.8% but cautioned it may be hard to hit in any quarter, and H1 margins are running below that range.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Q2 margin was below the 7.5-7.8% full-year guide, discounts and customer acquisition spend continue, and management itself said the margin guide may be hard to hit in any given quarter.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Management cited the Everlight collection (with Melorra), rising demand for 9ct/14ct and lab-grown diamond jewellery, and continued diamond promotions for Valentine's and the January-February season, though no specific launch dates were given.

rows.label: Discount-led customer acquisition pressuring margins
rows.why: Discounts were raised in Q2 to drive acquisition, management said it will keep investing in customer acquisition, and about 40-45% of footfall is new customers.

rows.label: Studded mix recovery to about 12.5%
rows.why: Management expects the studded share to return to about 12.5% from about 9.5-10% in the festive period, which would support margins, but this depends on demand and the festive mix normalising.

rows.label: Hedging ratio rise towards 65-70%
rows.why: Hedging is about 50% (down from a higher level, lower in Q2 at 40-50%), with a target of 65-70% only once gold prices stabilise, and no timeline was given.

tone.note: Management was confident on top-line growth (25-26% post-festive, 10 new stores) but defensive on margins, blaming discounts, hedging and franchisee inventory; analysts pressed on the reported EBITDA and pack margin figures, which were not fully resolved on the call.
